evidence: PC15 has no network connectivity through R24 Gi0/0.
Topology information indicates PC15 connects through SW15 to R24.
R24 show ip interface brief output shows GigabitEthernet0/0 is 192.168.250.1, administratively down, down.
root_cause: GigabitEthernet0/0 on R24 is administratively down, causing a loss of network connectivity for PC15.
verification: Run show ip interface brief on R24 and confirm GigabitEthernet0/0 status is up/up.
Manually test connectivity from PC15 after the approved change.
fix_steps: Access global configuration mode on R24.
Enter interface configuration mode for GigabitEthernet0/0.
Issue the 'no shutdown' command to bring the interface up.
Verify the interface status changes to up/up.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: show status is administratively down in configuration output.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Issue 'no shutdown' under interface show configuration mode.
